study_material.title: Analogy - Complete Study Notes
study_material.introduction: Analogy questions give a related pair (A : B) and ask you to complete C : ? with the SAME relationship. Name the relationship in one phrase first - worker:workplace, tool:action, part:whole - then apply it.
learning_objectives: Identify the exact relationship in the given pair
Solve letter and number analogies with position arithmetic
Eliminate options that fit a looser relationship

concepts.heading: 1. Word Analogies
concepts.body: Common relations: worker:workplace (doctor:hospital), tool:action (pen:write), animal:movement (bird:fly), creator:creation (author:book), part:whole (wheel:car), young one:animal (calf:cow), instrument:measure (thermometer:temperature). State the relation in a sentence and test each option against that sentence.

concepts.heading: 2. Direction Matters
concepts.body: Doctor:Hospital is worker to workplace. An option like School:Teacher reverses the direction and is wrong even though the words relate. Always preserve the order A-is-to-B.

concepts.heading: 3. Letter Analogies
concepts.body: Use alphabet positions. ACE : BDF is +1 on each letter. PRT : QSU applies the same. Reverse pairs (AZ, BY) use positions summing to 27. Write the numbers - do not eyeball.

concepts.heading: 4. Number Analogies
concepts.body: Typical rules: squares (4:16 as 7:49), cubes, x2 plus k, digit sums. Verify the rule works exactly on the given pair before applying, and check it fails on wrong options.

formulas: State the relation as a sentence, then test options
Letter shifts: same +/- k on every letter
shortcut_methods: Make the sentence specific: 'a calf is a BABY cow', not just 'related to cow'
For numbers, test squares and cubes first
common_mistakes: Accepting a vaguer relationship than the given pair's
Reversing the direction of the relation
Stopping at the first plausible option without testing all four
study_material.summary: Name the relation precisely, keep its direction, and verify with positions or arithmetic for letters and numbers.

solved_examples.question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
solved_examples.step_by_step: A doctor works in a hospital; a teacher works in a school.

solved_examples.question: Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
solved_examples.step_by_step: A pen is used to write; a knife is used to cut.
16 = 4 squared, so the answer is 7 squared = 49.

solved_examples.question: ACE : BDF :: PRT : ?
solved_examples.step_by_step: Each letter shifts +1: P->Q, R->S, T->U.

practice_questions.question: Thermometer : Temperature :: Barometer : ?
practice_questions.explanation: Instrument : quantity it measures. A barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

practice_questions.question: AZ : BY :: CX : ?
practice_questions.explanation: Pairs of opposite letters (sum 27), stepping inward: D(4) with W(23).

topic_test.title: Analogy - Topic Test
instructions: +1 for correct, -0.25 for wrong, 0 for unattempted.
State the relationship in a sentence before checking options.

questions.question: DE : 45 :: GH : ?
questions.explanation: Letter positions: D=4, E=5; G=7, H=8.

questions.question: KING : LJOH :: QUEEN : ?
questions.explanation: +1 on each letter: Q->R, U->V, E->F, E->F, N->O.
